text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Monday that it confirmed the ratings of Avenor Inc, following the company's failure to win shareholder approval for its proposed C$2.6 billion acquisition of Repap Enterprises Inc.

Ratings for Avenor's senior unsecured debentures and notes were confirmed at BB (high) and its convertible subordinated debentures at B (high), DBRS said. Avenor is also no longer under review with negative implications, DBRS said.

The rating agency said that although there is a potential for some form of new merger or other business arrangement involving Repap or its assets, it assumes Avenor will resume its normal operations and will continue with its cost containment and debt reduction policies.

The divestiture of the company's interest in the Gold River pulp mill and its 53 percent stake in Pacific Forest Products Ltd remains a possibility, with proceeds available for further debt reduction.
